resources.title: Active campaign onboarding policy

access.owner-player: read (bound version summary and option catalogs)

resources.projectionRule: Policy content is table-public to authenticated roles; internal review notes and unpublished drafts of a policy version are GM-only.

resources.title: Onboarding slots and queue

access.other-player: aggregate presence only (a slot exists / completed) without draft detail
access.diagnostic-operator: read (IDs and states, no draft payloads)

resources.projectionRule: Queue rows shown to non-GMs never include another profile's draft content, validation, or comments.

resources.title: Draft build choices and validation

access.gm: read (full projection incl. diagnostics); write only through bounded corrections
access.owner-player: read-write while draft or changes-requested; read-only otherwise
access.diagnostic-operator: structure and state codes only, no choice values

resources.projectionRule: Owner and GM receive structurally different projections built server-side; other roles receive nothing, not a redacted copy.

resources.title: Review comments and change requests
resources.projectionRule: GM-only notes live in a separate lane that is never serialized into owner or observer projections.

resources.title: GM corrections and acknowledgements

access.owner-player: read all corrections applied to own draft; write acknowledgements

resources.projectionRule: Corrections are receipt-backed operations; the owner always sees before/after values and rationale for their own draft.

resources.title: Immutable submission snapshots

access.diagnostic-operator: existence, revision, and fingerprint metadata only

resources.projectionRule: Snapshots are immutable server documents; clients never reconstruct them from local state.

resources.title: Completion and ready-for-play state

access.other-player: campaign-level aggregate (player X is ready) without build detail

resources.projectionRule: Created sheets then follow ordinary sheet visibility authority; the completion record itself exposes no private draft history.

resources.title: Aggregate UX metrics
resources.projectionRule: Aggregate-only: no campaign identities, character names, private choices, comments, or draft payloads are ever retained (P9-008).

trustBoundaries: No public signup, email invitation, password issuance, OAuth, or reusable secret links; identity remains the shared table password plus role cookie plus GM-created player profiles.
The selected player profile is the player identity; profile selection is client-remembered but every server decision re-validates profile-to-draft binding server-side.
Draft ownership binds to exactly one player profile at slot creation; only the GM can rebind it, and rebinding is a recorded operation.
Privacy is structural: role projections are computed server-side per request/event; clients never receive data they must hide.
Diagnostic access never includes choice values, comments, or identity beyond stable IDs and state codes.
Hard rule violations cannot be downgraded by any role; GM overrides operate only inside explicitly bounded policy or correction lanes.
